wizard.title: Goal build wizard
wizard.inputLabel: Describe your goal in one sentence
wizard.inputPlaceholder: e.g. Switch to PM in 6 months / Body fat to 18% in 3 months / PMP in half a year
wizard.noClarify: No clarifying questions — continue to WOOP.
wizard.obstaclePlanIntro: AI generated If-Then cards from your obstacle
wizard.ifThenWhen: If I hit this obstacle while working on “{goal}”

thenActions.time_limited: Then cut today’s plan to 3 items max — MIT only
thenActions.attention_scattered: Then put my phone in another room and start a 25-min focus timer
thenActions.procrastination_fear: Then spend only 10 minutes on the smallest viable version
thenActions.info_insufficient: Then spend 15 minutes researching and list what I still need
thenActions.energy_low: Then do a 5-minute warm-up before deciding whether to continue
thenActions.external_dependency: Then split out what I can do alone and start there

wizard.thenFallback: Then do a 5-minute minimum action first

completion.title: Memory profile created
completion.body: Your answers are in identity, working, and semantic memory.
completion.hint: You don’t need to fill every gap — mention things in chat and Companion will remember.

1.title: Basic identity
1.intro: Start with basics — how to address you and your life stage.

birthday.label: Birthday (YYYY-MM-DD; year and month is enough)

location.label: Which city are you based in now?

role.label: What's your main role right now?
role.placeholder: e.g. Product manager / Master’s student / Stay-at-home parent

2.title: Values & principles
2.intro: What you believe and won’t compromise — seeds your soul prompt.

core_beliefs.label: The 3 things you believe in most (one per line)
core_beliefs.hint: e.g. Long-term thinking beats short-term games; sincerity matters more than cleverness; health is the 1 and everything else the 0s.

3.title: Pivotal experiences
3.intro: One win, one failure, one turning point — how you decide.

pivotal_success.label: An experience that made you proudest
pivotal_success.hint: Briefly describe what happened and why it mattered to you (2–4 sentences is plenty).

pivotal_failure.label: A failure that left the deepest impression

pivotal_turning.label: Something that changed the direction of your life

4.title: Key relationships
4.intro: Five people who matter most — dates and check-ins.

important_people.label: List the 5 people who matter most to you (name + relationship, e.g. Mom — Lin)
important_people.placeholder: e.g. Partner — Alex / Mentor — Prof. Lee

relationship_notes.label: Relationship details you'd like GEDO to remember (optional)
relationship_notes.hint: e.g. Alex's birthday is 8/12; I call my parents every Sunday.

5.title: Capability map
5.intro: Rate the 8 life areas; optional evidence per dimension.

life_wheel_self_score.label: Rate your 8-dimension Life Flower (0 = no investment at all, 10 = your ideal state right now)

capability_evidence.label: Pick 1–3 dimensions and give one concrete piece of evidence for each (optional)
capability_evidence.hint: e.g. Career 8 — led project X solo within six months; Health 4 — haven't worked out in the past month.

6.title: Current anxieties
6.intro: Top 3 things keeping you up — daily planning will prioritize them.

top_3_challenges.label: Your 3 biggest current challenges / anxieties
top_3_challenges.placeholder: One per line — the more specific the better

why_now.label: Why now? (optional)
why_now.hint: e.g. there is an external deadline, or some event triggered reflection.

7.title: Long-term vision
7.intro: Who you want to be in 5–10 years — your north star.

future_5y.label: In 5 years, who do you hope to become / what do you want to be doing?
future_5y.hint: No need to be comprehensive — just the 1–2 most important changes.

north_star.label: Your one-sentence north star (GEDO keeps it in the system prompt at all times)
north_star.placeholder: e.g. Build products that help ordinary people make better long-term decisions.
